content.stem: 欧盟《第六项反洗钱指令》(6AMLD):

options.A: 将反洗钱监管范围扩大至众筹平台和职业足球俱乐部
options.B: 取消了要求欧盟委员会进行风险评估的规定
options.C: 设立了一个欧盟中央监管机构来打击洗钱活动
options.D: 加强有关提交至中央受益所有权登记册的数据准确性的规定

options_en.A: Extended AML oversight to crowdfunding platforms and professional football clubs
options_en.B: Eliminated the requirement for the European Commission to conduct a risk assessment
options_en.C: Created a central EU watchdog to combat money laundering
options_en.D: Strengthened provisions relating to the accuracy of data submitted to central beneficial ownership registries
